datasets.title: Chicago census tracts: median household income
datasets.description: 856 census tracts in the City of Chicago with median household income (US dollars), as polygons.
datasets.source: US Census Bureau: American Community Survey 2018-2022 5-year estimates (table B19013) with 2022 TIGER/Line census tract boundaries, clipped to the City of Chicago boundary. Retrieved with the tidycensus and tigris R packages.
datasets.licence: Public domain (work of the US federal government)
datasets.attribution: Source: US Census Bureau, 2018-2022 American Community Survey 5-year estimates (median household income, table B19013) and 2022 TIGER/Line census tract boundaries.
datasets.notice: This product uses the Census Bureau Data API but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau.

datasets.title: City of Chicago boundary
datasets.description: The City of Chicago boundary as a single polygon.
datasets.source: US Census Bureau: 2022 TIGER/Line cartographic boundary file for places (Illinois), Chicago. Retrieved with the tigris R package.
datasets.licence: Public domain (work of the US federal government)
datasets.attribution: Source: US Census Bureau, 2022 TIGER/Line cartographic boundary file (places).

datasets.title: The Childhood Lottery: England upper-tier local authorities
datasets.description: 153 upper-tier local authorities in England (polygons) with the Children's Commissioner's Childhood Lottery measures: 128 metrics (values and 0-10 scores) across six pillars plus an overall score, one row per authority. See childhood_lottery_metrics for what each column means.
datasets.source: Children's Commissioner for England, The Childhood Lottery (published 19 October 2026), full dataset workbook (https://www.childrenscommissioner.gov.uk/the-childhood-lottery/), reshaped from long to wide (one row per local authority; _value and _score columns per metric; Yes/No answers coded 1/0). Boundaries: ONS Counties and Unitary Authorities (December 2025) Boundaries UK BGC, England only, British National Grid, simplified to 100 m for teaching.
datasets.licence: Free to download from the Children's Commissioner (no formal licence stated); ONS boundaries under the Open Government Licence v3.0
datasets.attribution: Source: Children's Commissioner for England, The Childhood Lottery (2026). Boundaries: Office for National Statistics licensed under the Open Government Licence v.3.0. Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2025.
datasets.notice: The Children's Commissioner publishes this dataset for free download but states no formal licence ("All rights reserved"). Klausmate redistributes it, unaltered in content, for teaching with the source credited. Boundaries contain OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2025.

datasets.title: The Childhood Lottery: metric dictionary
datasets.description: What each column of childhood_lottery means: pillar, full metric name, description, unit, source, whether it is scored, England average.
datasets.source: Children's Commissioner for England, The Childhood Lottery (published 19 October 2026), full dataset workbook (https://www.childrenscommissioner.gov.uk/the-childhood-lottery/), reshaped from long to wide (one row per local authority; _value and _score columns per metric; Yes/No answers coded 1/0).
datasets.licence: Free to download from the Children's Commissioner (no formal licence stated)
datasets.attribution: Source: Children's Commissioner for England, The Childhood Lottery (2026).
datasets.notice: The Children's Commissioner publishes this dataset for free download but states no formal licence ("All rights reserved"). Klausmate redistributes it, unaltered in content, for teaching with the source credited.

datasets.title: Birmingham LSOAs: change in the share of the Black African population, for multilevel modelling
datasets.description: 639 Lower layer Super Output Areas in Birmingham (polygons), the modelling rows for a multilevel model: the outcome y_change (2011 minus 2001 share of Birmingham's Black African population, in percentage points) and a normalised version, the 2001 Black African percentage, the 2019 IMD score, plus the MSOA ethnic diversity, ward tenure and constituency 2010 vote variables copied down, with MSOA, ward and constituency codes. See birmingham_dictionary.
datasets.source: Office for National Statistics (via Nomis): Census 2001 table KS006 (ethnic group, output areas) and Census 2011 tables KS201EW (ethnic group), KS018 / KS402EW (tenure) for Birmingham; ONS lookups between 2001 and 2011 output areas, LSOAs, MSOAs and wards; MHCLG English Indices of Deprivation 2019 (File 7); ONS 2011 boundaries (BGC / GCB, generalised and clipped) and 2010-2024 constituency boundaries, simplified by ONS, British National Grid. House of Commons Library, Election Results (general election 6 May 2010, https://electionresults.parliament.uk), under the Open Parliament Licence v3.0. Built with tools/prepare_birmingham.R.
datasets.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0; election results under the Open Parliament Licence v3.0
datasets.attribution: Source: Office for National Statistics (Census 2001 and 2011, via Nomis; 2011 boundaries) and Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government (English Indices of Deprivation 2019), licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Contains National Statistics data © Crown copyright and database right 2026. Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2026. Contains Parliamentary information licensed under the Open Parliament Licence v3.0 (House of Commons Library, 2010 general election results).
datasets.notice: Both licences require the attribution shown. The Census, IMD and boundary data are Crown copyright and licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0; the 2010 election results are Parliamentary copyright and licensed under the Open Parliament Licence v3.0.
